passages.text: Woe to the land of whirring wings, along the rivers of Cush, which sends couriers by sea, in papyrus vessels on the waters. Go, swift messengers, to a people tall and smooth-skinned, to a people widely feared, to a powerful nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers.
passages.sermon:
This passage speaks about a distant land.
This land lies beyond the rivers of Cush.
The land is known for the sound of whirring wings.
People in this land send messengers by sea.
They use boats made of papyrus to travel on the waters.
God commands the messengers to go quickly.
They must go to a nation that is tall and smooth-skinned.
This nation is widely feared by others.
The people are powerful and strong.
They speak a language that is different and strange.
Many rivers divide their land.
passages.original: ה֥וֹי אֶ֖רֶץ צִלְצַ֣ל כְּנָפָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מֵעֵ֖בֶר לְנַֽהֲרֵי־ כֽוּשׁ׃ הַשֹּׁלֵ֨חַ בַּיָּ֜ם צִירִ֗ים וּבִכְלֵי־ גֹמֶא֮ עַל־ פְּנֵי־ מַיִם֒ לְכ֣וּ׀ מַלְאָכִ֣ים קַלִּ֗ים אֶל־ גּוֹי֙ מְמֻשָּׁ֣ךְ וּמוֹרָ֔ט אֶל־ עַ֥ם נוֹרָ֖א מִן־ ה֣וּא וָהָ֑לְאָה גּ֚וֹי קַו־ קָ֣ו וּמְבוּסָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ בָּזְא֥וּ נְהָרִ֖ים אַרְצֽוֹ׃

passages.text: All you people of the world and dwellers of the earth, when a banner is raised on the mountains, you will see it; when a ram’s horn sounds, you will hear it.
passages.sermon:
All people live on the earth.
All people dwell in the world.
You will see a banner when someone raises it on the mountains.
You will hear the sound when someone blows a ram’s horn.
passages.original: כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י תֵבֵ֖ל וְשֹׁ֣כְנֵי אָ֑רֶץ כִּנְשֹׂא־ נֵ֤ס הָרִים֙ תִּרְא֔וּ וְכִתְקֹ֥עַ שׁוֹפָ֖ר תִּשְׁמָֽעוּ׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the LORD has told me: “I will quietly look on from My dwelling place, like shimmering heat in the sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He said, “I will remain quiet.
I will watch from My dwelling place.
I will be like shimmering heat in the sunshine.
I will be like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
passages.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י אֶשְׁקוֹטָה וְאַבִּ֣יטָה בִמְכוֹנִ֑י כְּחֹ֥ם צַח֙ עֲלֵי־ א֔וֹר כְּעָ֥ב טַ֖ל בְּחֹ֥ם קָצִֽיר׃

passages.text: For before the harvest, when the blossom is gone and the flower becomes a ripening grape, He will cut off the shoots with a pruning knife and remove and discard the branches.
passages.sermon:
God acts before the harvest.
The blossom will disappear.
The flower will turn into a ripening grape.
God will cut off the shoots with a pruning knife.
He will remove the branches.
He will throw the branches away.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ לִפְנֵ֤י קָצִיר֙ כְּתָם־ פֶּ֔רַח וּבֹ֥סֶר גֹּמֵ֖ל יִֽהְיֶ֣ה נִצָּ֑ה וְכָרַ֤ת הַזַּלְזַלִּים֙ בַּמַּזְמֵר֔וֹת וְאֶת־ הַנְּטִישׁ֖וֹת הֵסִ֥יר הֵתַֽז׃

passages.text: They will all be left to the mountain birds of prey, and to the beasts of the land. The birds will feed on them in summer, and all the wild animals in winter.
passages.sermon:
God will leave these people for destruction.
He will give them to the birds of prey in the mountains.
He will give them to the wild animals of the land.
The birds will eat them during the summer.
The wild animals will eat them during the winter.
passages.original: יֵעָזְב֤וּ יַחְדָּו֙ לְעֵ֣יט הָרִ֔ים וּֽלְבֶהֱמַ֖ת הָאָ֑רֶץ וְקָ֤ץ עָלָיו֙ הָעַ֔יִט וְכָל־ בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ עָלָ֥יו תֶּחֱרָֽף׃

passages.text: At that time gifts will be brought to the LORD of Hosts— from a people tall and smooth-skinned, from a people widely feared, from a powerful nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers— to Mount Zion, the place of the Name of the LORD of Hosts.
passages.sermon:
At that time, people will bring gifts to the LORD of Hosts.
These people are tall and smooth-skinned.
They come from a nation that is widely feared.
This nation is powerful.
They speak a strange language.
Rivers divide their land.
They will bring their gifts to Mount Zion.
Mount Zion is the place of the Name of the LORD of Hosts.
passages.original: בָּעֵת֩ הַהִ֨יא יֽוּבַל־ שַׁ֜י לַיהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת עַ֚ם מְמֻשָּׁ֣ךְ וּמוֹרָ֔ט וּמֵעַ֥ם נוֹרָ֖א מִן־ ה֣וּא וָהָ֑לְאָה גּ֣וֹי׀ קַו־ קָ֣ו וּמְבוּסָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּזְא֤וּ נְהָרִים֙ אַרְצ֔וֹ אֶל־ מְק֛וֹם שֵׁם־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת הַר־ צִיּֽוֹן׃ס
